therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Asian patients with acute coronary syndrome undergoing PCI
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with MACE (death, MI, target vessel revascularization) at 30 days post-PCI

biomarker_changes: CRP percent change at 8h: atorvastatin 205.25% vs usual care 234.77% (p=0.7554)
CRP percent change at 24h: atorvastatin 594.07% vs usual care 543.50% (p=0.7436)
CRP percent change at 30 days: atorvastatin 9.01% vs usual care 67.23% (p=0.4741)
Elevated CK-MB at 8h: atorvastatin 11.3% vs usual care 13.6%
Elevated CK-MB at 24h: atorvastatin 15.6% vs usual care 18.9%
Elevated Troponin I at 8h: atorvastatin 40.4% vs usual care 35.5%
Elevated Troponin I at 24h: atorvastatin 49.7% vs usual care 44.4%
Elevated Myoglobin at 8h: atorvastatin 8.2% vs usual care 10.8%
subgroup_findings: Death at 30 days: atorvastatin 0.6% vs usual care 0.6%
MI at 30 days: atorvastatin 14.1% vs usual care 15.1%
Target vessel revascularization at 30 days: 0% in both arms
MACE at 8h: atorvastatin 6.7% vs usual care 6.4% (p=1.0000)
MACE at 24h: atorvastatin 13.5% vs usual care 15.1% (p=0.7896)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and similar between arms
Myocardial infarction SAE: atorvastatin 3/245, usual care 4/250

dose_info.dose: 80 mg pre-PCI (12h prior), then 40 mg pre-PCI (2h prior), then 40 mg daily (atorvastatin group); 40 mg daily (usual care group)
dose_info.schedule: Loading: 80 mg at 12h pre-PCI + 40 mg at 2h pre-PCI; maintenance: 40 mg once daily for 30 days post-PCI

context.comparator: atorvastatin 40 mg daily post-PCI (no pre-treatment loading)
